title: Tim Drake as Saint Mary
alt: Digital illustration of a modern character against a grey background with a bright, pale yellow, round stained-glass rosetta behind their head, as if a halo. The character is shown knees-up, in an relaxed pose. He is smiling gently and is looking at the viewer. He is dressed in white, loose t-shirt and pants, and has blue bathrobe hanging from the back of his head by the hood. He is holding a redhairbrush in his right hand.
caption: commissioned illustration for my fanfic 'deus ex homine', 2023
